title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions would change if we used a different training dataset. Consider how removing a feature might affect this variability.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it might simplify the model. A simpler model often has less variance because it is less sensitive to fluctuations in the training data.

title: Choosing the Effect on Variance
text: What is the possible effect on model variance when a feature is removed?
